title: MSRP Domain re-declaration is always JoinIn; must be JoinMt when no Domain registration is IN
body:
Found by the in-house qualification run of 2026-10-18 on the AX7101 (dev e9cbb676, processor 2cbed0a9), with a test machine directly on the DUT's port.

**Behaviour.** With no other station declaring an MSRP Domain on the link, every periodic and LeaveAll re-declaration of the DUT's Domain attribute (class A, priority 3, VID 2) is encoded **JoinIn**.

**Required.** IEEE 802.1Q-2018 10.7.6.3: the sJ action encodes JoinIn only when the attribute's Registrar is IN, and JoinMt otherwise. Milan v1.2 4.2.7.1 requires a PAAD to support MRP. With no Domain registration, the re-join must be JoinMt.

**Source.** `hdl/srp/KL_srp_domain.sv:186-188` sends EV_JOININ_C for the re-join and never reads the Domain's registration state. `:167-169` sends the single New at link rise. See also `docs/architecture/10_srp_engine.md:265`.

**Done when:**
- the Domain re-declaration is JoinMt when no Domain registration is IN, and JoinIn when one is;
- a suite case covers both, each with a planted mutant;
- the processor's suites and the parent's consumer gates pass.
